# The Special Wedding

> All-in-one wedding planning operating system and CRM for professional wedding planners. Replaces the multi-tool stack (HoneyBook + Aisle Planner + Squarespace + DocuSign + Honeybook payments) with a single workspace covering guest management, RSVPs, seating, vendor contracts, budgets, day-of timelines, AI-assisted contract drafting, SMS reminders, and a real-time couple portal.

The Special Wedding is built for solo planners and boutique agencies running 5-50 weddings a year. Couples access their own portal where they can RSVP, view timelines, complete planner-assigned forms, and message the planner directly. Vendors are managed through a structured contract pipeline with budget propagation. The platform is multi-tenant — each planner is a tenant with their own couples, vendors, weddings, and team members.

## Platform Overview

- Wedding planning OS for professionals running multiple events simultaneously
- Multi-tenant architecture: each planner gets a private workspace
- Couple portal: RSVPs, timelines, gallery, forms, planner messaging
- Vendor CRM: contracts, budgets, deliverables, payment tracking
- Guest management: invites, plus-ones, dietary requirements, seating
- AI tools: contract drafting, vendor outreach, day-of timeline generation
- Day-of execution: SMS reminders to guests, vendor check-in, live status

## Core Workflows

### Onboarding a New Wedding

A planner creates a wedding from their dashboard, invites the couple via email (the couple receives a magic-link invitation to their dedicated portal), and configures the wedding profile: ceremony and reception venues, guest list, budget envelopes, vendor categories, and key dates. The platform then enables couple-side features like RSVP collection, gallery uploads, and form responses.

### Vendor Contracts

Vendors are added to a wedding with a contract pipeline: draft → sent → signed → in-progress → completed. AI-assisted drafting generates a first-pass contract from a structured prompt (vendor type, service description, payment terms). The planner reviews, redlines, and sends via e-signature. Budget envelopes are automatically updated when contracts move between stages.

### Guest Management

Guest lists support plus-ones, dietary requirements, accessibility notes, and table assignments. RSVPs are collected through tokenized public links — no guest needs an account. Late or missing RSVPs trigger automated SMS reminders. Seating charts are built with drag-and-drop, with capacity warnings and conflict detection (e.g. seated relatives who shouldn't share a table).

### Day-Of Execution

The day-of dashboard surfaces the full timeline, vendor status, guest check-ins, and outstanding tasks. SMS reminders fire automatically based on the timeline. Photos uploaded by guests appear in the couple's gallery in real time. The planner can broadcast updates to vendors or specific guest segments.

## Pricing

- Starter: $29/month per planner — solo planners, up to 5 active weddings
- Pro: $59/month per planner — agencies, unlimited weddings, team members, advanced AI
- Free 30-day trial on either tier, no credit card required to start

## Audience

Designed for professional wedding planners (independent and agency), not couples planning their own wedding. Couples engage through the portal their planner invites them to, not through self-signup. The marketing site at thespecialwedding.io targets planners; the couple portal is at thespecialwedding.io/couple after invitation.

## Company

The Special Wedding is operated by JOATLABS. The platform is purpose-built for professional wedding planning workflows rather than generic project management retrofitted for events. Engineering is in active development with a focus on AI-assisted planning workflows, real-time couple-planner communication, and end-to-end day-of execution support.
